description: This file manages the initialization and provision of async database sessions using SQLAlchemy's async capabilities. It configures the database engine, provides a URL conversion utility, and exposes a FastAPI dependency for obtaining database sessions.

methods.name: str _to_asyncpg_url(url: str)
methods.description: Converts PostgreSQL URLs to be compatible with asyncpg and SQLAlchemy.

methods.name: None init_engine(settings: Settings)
methods.description: Initializes the global AsyncEngine and AsyncSession factory based on provided settings.

methods.name: AsyncIterator[AsyncSession] get_db_session()
methods.description: Asynchronous generator providing a database session, suitable for dependency injection in FastAPI.
